title: (No AI) We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![A number of cursors point toward an unhappy face on a laptop](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23318433/akrales_220309_4977_0182.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Over the last week or so, we have seen a nationwide FAA ground stop, a multi-day Outlook outage that brought entire companies to a standstill, and a banking outage at [JPMorgan Chase](https://apnews.com/article/bank-outage-chase-wells-fargo-truist-50fee2693c22f597fa6ca51a97ef2cda). But the consensus is that [there are more to come](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/21/us/politics/tech-outages-ai-disruptions.html). Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told _[CNN](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/22/jay-clayton-tech-outages-faa-microsoft-thanksgiving.html)_:

> "The American people should be prepared for a great deal of investment in upgrading our systems; they should be prepared for investment in cybersecurity, and they should be prepared that any time there is a step change in technology, a step change in both compute and applications, there will be bumps in the road."

title: (No AI) Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![The Binding of Isaac: Repenentance Plus thumbnail.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/j7yPmbNCP4I-HD.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The _Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus_ has spent the last few days getting [review-bombed on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3353470/The_Binding_of_Isaac_Repentance/) after it was discovered that a particular segment of the game [used AI music](https://www.ign.com/articles/the-binding-of-isaac-dev-removes-undisclosed-ai-generated-music-from-repentance-following-creator-response-review-bombing). Reddit user [ShweetsStuff](https://www.reddit.com/r/bindingofisaac/comments/1y1qqut/reps_gtavi_runs_music_is_100_generated_by_suno_ai/) discovered the songs used during a _Grand Theft Auto_\-themed section. They found several audio files with Suno metadata that pointed back to the tracks on Suno's site.

Creator Edmund McMillen took to X to [apologize](https://x.com/edmundmcmillen/status/2124169167880470745?s=20) and claimed he "had no idea" the in-game GTA parody used generative AI music. Adding to the drama, Valve requires developers to [disclose how and when they use generative AI](https://www.ign.com/articles/valve-announces-changes-to-how-its-handling-ai-content-on-steam) in the development process, and Nicalis, Inc., the studio behin …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/games/1039770/binding-of-isaac-ai-music)
